arguments.sql_query:
DECLARE @as_of_date date = (SELECT MAX(observation_period_end_date) FROM omop.observation_period);
WITH adult_current_population AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id
  FROM omop.person p
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = p.person_id
  WHERE op.observation_period_start_date <= @as_of_date
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= @as_of_date
    AND DATEADD(year, 18, CAST(p.birth_datetime AS date)) <= @as_of_date
),
ms_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 374919
),
adult_current_ms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT acp.person_id
  FROM adult_current_population acp
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = acp.person_id
  JOIN ms_concepts mc ON mc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE co.condition_start_date <= @as_of_date
)
SELECT
  @as_of_date AS as_of_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_population) AS adult_population,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_ms) AS adult_ms_cases,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_ms) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_population),0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS prevalence_percent,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_ms) * 100000.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_population),0) AS decimal(12,2)) AS prevalence_per_100k

arguments.sql_query:
WITH asof AS (
  SELECT MAX(observation_period_end_date) AS as_of_date
  FROM omop.observation_period
),
adult_current_population AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id
  FROM omop.person p
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = p.person_id
  CROSS JOIN asof a
  WHERE op.observation_period_start_date <= a.as_of_date
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= a.as_of_date
    AND DATEADD(year, 18, CAST(p.birth_datetime AS date)) <= a.as_of_date
),
ms_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 374919
),
adult_current_ms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT acp.person_id
  FROM adult_current_population acp
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = acp.person_id
  JOIN ms_concepts mc ON mc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  CROSS JOIN asof a
  WHERE co.condition_start_date <= a.as_of_date
)
SELECT
  a.as_of_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_population) AS adult_population,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_ms) AS adult_ms_cases,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_ms) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_population),0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS prevalence_percent,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_ms) * 100000.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adult_current_population),0) AS decimal(12,2)) AS prevalence_per_100k
FROM asof a
